stage1.impression: A clean, competent night visualization: the rim-lit globe reads at once and its coloured shadow on the paving is the best idea in the frame, but the place around it is generic CG. The houses are flat dark-brown slabs with card windows and no brick, the paving and water are smooth, the 5000 K spot pool reads as a stage light dropped on the quay, and the lower-left lamp pool burns brighter than the work. A jury would see a specific, striking work, but in a placeholder Amsterdam rather than a real canal at night.

blocking_9: The houses across the canal read as real Amsterdam brick: visible coursing and mortar, per-house colour and height variation, cornices and hoist beams, lit windows with interiors (curtains, ceiling lamps, depth) instead of flat glowing cards
The quay paving reads as brick or stone pavers with joints, wear and damp sheen, and a dressed stone kerb at the water's edge
The canal water carries ripple and broken reflections across its whole width, not a flat dark band
The globe is the brightest and most saturated thing in the frame; nothing (lamp pool, spot pool) out-shines it
The hard spot's pool reads as part of the work (warm-neutral, softer edge, coloured shadow dominant) rather than a cold theatre spot
No flat-shaded mannequin figures; any people read as people at their distance
No visible grain in the sky and smooth gradients in the lamp halo

defects.what: Facades are flat untextured dark-brown planes; a wall strip between windows measures lum_range 30.5 with no brick or mortar structure; all houses share one colour
Lit windows are uniform flat cards (white, beige, tan) with no interior depth, curtains or lamps; unlit windows are pure black glass with identical white frames
Figure across the water is a flat dark capsule mannequin standing against a facade, reads as a placeholder
Canal water band near the far quay is dead flat: lum_range 6.2, no ripple or reflection break
Quay paving is a smooth plane with no pavers, joints or kerb; lower-left lamp pool reaches lum_median 188 (p95 216), far brighter than the work
Spot pool is cold blue-white (5000 K against a 2700 K scene), hard-edged (6 px 10-90 edge), reads as a theatre spot
Plinth is a near-black featureless cylinder, lum_median 13.9, no steel sheen or edge highlight
Barrier ring rope and posts cut across the foreground and the globe's base, clutter the read of the plinth and the shadow
Visible noise/grain in the sky and lamp halo
Disc faces read as dark smoked glass rather than clear; the rims glow but the globe sits at lum_median 33.5, barely above the facade behind it (29.2)
Gable tops and chimneys are blocky primitives with no stepped/bell gable detail at this distance

changes.problem: The houses across the canal read as CG slabs, which is what makes the whole frame read as a render.

evidence.measured: wall strip lum_range 30.5, lum_p5 16 / p95 46.5, no visible coursing; all facades r/g/b ~44/26/20

change.setting: materials' finish of the houses (the brick)
change.from: one flat dark-brown shader on every house
change.to: a scaled brick texture (~65 x 215 mm bricks, light mortar, bump 1-2 mm) with per-house hue/value variation (dark red-brown, near-black painted, one ochre, one grey-green), white-painted cornices and window frames, hoist beams at the gables

changes.expected: Facades carry visible brick texture and the row reads as individual canal houses; wall texture adds local contrast.

changes.problem: The lower-left lamp pool is the brightest surface in the frame and pulls the eye from the globe.

change.to: 2 x point, 50 W, 2700 K (or move the near lamp further left/back out of the bottom-left corner)

changes.expected: The lamp pool falls to a warm mid-tone; the globe becomes the brightest element.

changes.problem: The hard spot's pool reads as a cold theatre spot rather than the work's own coloured shadow.

evidence.measured: rgb median 83/61/62 inside a warm scene; edge 10-90 width 6 px, step 66.7

change.to: 600 W, cone 20 deg with a soft blend (~0.15), 4000 K

changes.expected: Pool reads warm-neutral and less hot; coloured shadow stays crisp because the source stays small, but the pool edge feathers.

changes.problem: The globe sits barely above the facade behind it in brightness; clear faces read as smoked glass.

evidence.measured: lum_median 33.5 vs facade 29.2; clip 1.23% only on rims

change.to: 0.30, with disc faces at full clarity (no tint absorption on the faces beyond the specified tint)

changes.expected: Rims glow clearly brighter and spill colour onto the faces and plinth; globe region median rises.

changes.problem: Lit windows are flat cards with no interior, which reads as a model.

evidence.measured: lit panes are uniform fills (white, tan, beige) with no gradient or interior detail

change.setting: the houses across: the lit windows
change.to: 0.25 lit at 2700 K with interior cards (ceiling pendant, curtain half-drawn, bookshelf) behind glass with a slight reflection, glow 0.08; a few at 3000-3200 K for variety

changes.expected: Windows read as rooms behind glass, warm and varied, not white cards.

changes.problem: The canal water is a flat dark plane in places with no ripple.

change.to: fine wind ripple (amplitude ~5-10 mm, scale 0.2-0.5 m) across the whole canal so window and lamp reflections break into vertical streaks

changes.expected: Reflections of lit windows and the lamp break into streaks across the whole width.

changes.problem: The quay surface is a smooth plane with no pavers or kerb, and the plinth is a crushed featureless cylinder.

evidence.measured: plinth lum_median 13.9, p5 6.5; paving shows no joints at 2x crop

change.to: red-brown clinker brick pavers in herringbone with dark joints and a faint damp sheen (roughness 0.35-0.5), a 300 mm grey stone kerb at the water edge; plinth blackened steel with roughness ~0.4 so it picks up rim colour and an edge highlight

changes.expected: Paving and plinth read as real materials; the plinth carries coloured reflections.

changes.problem: The mannequin figure and the foreground barrier rope cheapen the frame.

evidence.measured: flat capsule figure; barrier rope crosses 0-760 px at the base of the globe

change.setting: the street: figures and the barrier ring
change.from: 3 capsule figures across the water; barrier ring r 2.4 m, rope at 0.45 m
change.to: replace figures with scanned/realistic people, mostly in motion or silhouetted on the far quay, or remove them; drop the rope to a low ground ring or remove it from this frame; add a bicycle against a far railing and a bench as street life

changes.expected: Foreground is clear, the plinth and shadow read unbroken, and life cues read as real.

out_of_scope.request: Retune the globe's disc colours or rim tints for better balance
out_of_scope.why: The globe's design and colours are fixed by the card.
